stdout.text:
Estimate true cell barcodes from FASTQ

Usage: <BIN> whitelist [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -I, --stdin <FILE>
          Input FASTQ (gzip by .gz; omit or - for stdin) [alias: --input]
  -S, --stdout <FILE>
          Whitelist TSV output (omit or - for stdout) [alias: --output]
  -p, --bc-pattern <PATTERN>
          Barcode pattern; N marks UMI bases, C marks cell bases
      --read2-in <FILE>
          Paired read 2 input (not implemented)
      --method <METHOD>
          Count method: reads [default: reads]
      --knee-method <METHOD>
          Knee method: distance or density [default: distance]
      --expect-cells <EXPECT_CELLS>
          Prior expectation on the number of cells
      --verbose
          Print detailed build information together with --version
      --set-cell-number <SET_CELL_NUMBER>
          Accept exactly this many barcodes
      --error-correct-threshold <ERROR_CORRECT_THRESHOLD>
          Hamming distance for correction [default: 1]
      --ed-above-threshold <MODE>
          Correct barcodes above the knee: discard or correct
      --subset-reads <SUBSET_READS>
          Use only the first N reads [default: 100000000]
      --quiet
          Suppress informational output
  -L, --log <FILE>
          Log file (defaults to stderr)
  -h, --help
          Print help

EXAMPLES:
  <BIN> whitelist -I reads.fastq.gz -S whitelist.tsv -p NNNNCCCC
  <BIN> whitelist -I reads.fastq -S wl.tsv -p NNNNCCCC --knee-method density

NOTES:
  N marks UMI bases and C marks cell bases in the pattern.
  The output is barcode, corrected barcodes, count, corrected counts.
  --method umis and paired input are rejected in this build.
